chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying: “If word reaches you about an Occultation concerning the Master of this affair, then do not deny it.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.صَاحِبِ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: the Master of this affair; a designation for the Imam
key_terms.غَيْبَةٌ: Occultation; the Imam’s hidden state from public appearance
key_terms.فَلَا تُنْكِرُوهَا: do not deny it; a command to affirm and not reject the occultation

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the ghaybah of the Sahib al-Amr?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs the believers not to reject the ghaybah (Occultation) of the Sahib of this affair when it is conveyed to them. It affirms the reality of the Imam’s occultation as a matter to be accepted within the doctrine of Imamate and the signs of the end.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘If an Occultation reaches you all regarding the Master<sup>asws</sup> of this command, so do not be denying it’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from from his father from ibn abu “Umayr from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following.
“I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, “I the person in charge of this task (Leadership with Divine Authority) will disappear from public sight you must not reject it.”
